001package dayplanner;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import javax.swing.JTextField;
005
006/**
007 * Represents the Swing GUI add window. Extends {@link GUIWindow} to share
008 * common window configuration, layout, and component handling with other GUI
009 * windows such as {@link GUISearchWindow}.
010 */
011public class GUIAddWindow extends GUIWindow {
012
013    /**
014     * Create a new Swing GUI add window.
015     * 
016     * @param activities Instantiated ActivityList.
017     */
018    public GUIAddWindow(ActivityList activities) {
019        super(activities);
020    }
021
022    @Override
023    public String getWindowTitle() {
024        return "DayPlanner - Add";
025    }
026
027    @Override
028    public String getHeaderText() {
029        return "<html><b>Adding an activity:</b></html>";
030    }
031
032    @Override
033    public String getActionButtonLabel() {
034        return "Add";
035    }
036
037    @Override
038    public String getActionButtonCommand() {
039        return "ADD";
040    }
041
042    @Override
043    public String[] getFieldLabels() {
044        return new String[] {
045            "<html>Type <code>('home', 'school', or 'other')</code></html>",
046            "Title:",
047            "<html>Starting time <code>(YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM)</code>:</html>",
048            "<html>Ending time <code>(YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM)</code>:</html>",
049            "<html>Comment <i>(optional)</i>:</html>",
050            "<html>Location <i>(if creating Other Activity only)</i>:</html>"
051        };
052    }
053
054    @Override
055    public boolean executeAction() {
056        return tryCreate(activities, centerFields);
057    }
058
059    /**
060     * Input-validate and try to create an activity and add it to the list.
061     * 
062     * @param activities   Instantiated ActivityList.
063     * @param centerFields All of the JTextField instances in the order: type,
064     *                     title, start time, end time, comment, location.
065     * @return true if activity was created and added, false otherwise.
066     */
067    public boolean tryCreate(ActivityList activities, ArrayList<JTextField> centerFields) {
068        if (activities == null || centerFields == null || centerFields.size() < 6) {
069            addMessage("Internal error: missing form fields.");
070            return false;
071        }
072
073        // 1. Activity type
074        String typeStr = centerFields.get(0).getText().trim();
075        if (typeStr.isEmpty()) {
076            addMessage("Activity type cannot be empty. Please enter 'home', 'school', or 'other'.");
077            return false;
078        }
079        ActivityType type = ActivityType.parse(typeStr);
080        if (type == null) {
081            addMessage("Invalid activity type: \"" + typeStr + "\". Please enter 'home', 'school', or 'other'.");
082            return false;
083        }
084
085        // 2. Title
086        String title = centerFields.get(1).getText().trim();
087        if (title.isEmpty()) {
088            addMessage("Title cannot be empty.");
089            return false;
090        }
091
092        // 3. Start time
093        Time sTime = parseAndValidateTime(centerFields.get(2).getText(), "Starting time");
094        if (sTime == null)
095            return false;
096
097        // 4. End time
098        Time eTime = parseAndValidateTime(centerFields.get(3).getText(), "Ending time");
099        if (eTime == null)
100            return false;
101
102        // 5. Start vs End order
103        if (sTime.compareTo(eTime) >= 0) {
104            addMessage("Ending time (" + eTime + ") has to be after starting time (" + sTime + ").");
105            return false;
106        }
107
108        // 6. Comment (optional)
109        String comment = centerFields.get(4).getText().trim();
110        if (comment.isEmpty())
111            comment = null;
112
113        // 7. Location (required for other)
114        String location = null;
115        if (type == ActivityType.OTHER) {
116            location = centerFields.get(5).getText().trim();
117            if (location.isEmpty()) {
118                addMessage("Location cannot be empty for Other activities.");
119                return false;
120            }
121        }
122
123        // 8. Instantiate and add
124        try {
125            Activity act = switch (type) {
126                case HOME   -> new HomeActivity(title, sTime, eTime, comment);
127                case SCHOOL -> new SchoolActivity(title, sTime, eTime, comment);
128                case OTHER  -> new OtherActivity(title, sTime, eTime, comment, location);
129            };
130
131            activities.add(act);
132            addMessage("Added successfully: " + act.toString());
133            return true;
134        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
135            addMessage("Error creating activity: " + e.getMessage());
136            return false;
137        }
138    }
139}
